pipelineGeometry.orbits: inner radius clamp(0.25w, 210, 300) for slots 0-2; outer radius min(inner + 200, room before review) for slots 3-5
pipelineGeometry.queuePreview: Queued tasks that fit: [112, 92 + 76i]; overflow shows a +N more action in the last place
pipelineGeometry.routing: Comet on the planner ring at angle -0.9 + 0.36slot
pipelineGeometry.reviewPreview: Review, merging and failed tasks that fit: [w - 112, 92 + 88i]; overflow shows +N more
pipelineGeometry.completedPreview: Latest completed tasks as linked stars from [w - 44, h - 66] leftwards in 30 steps, clear of the lowest slot
pipelineGeometry.viewport: Native scrollbar on both axes; control and status strips scroll horizontally.
pipelineGeometry.inspectorWidth: min(330, logical pane width - 16); subtract 330 from available scene width only when docked
pipelineGeometry.inspectorScroll: Shrinkable vertical body owns scrolling; rows retain content height and full queue access.
pipelineGeometry.zoomNormalization: bounds.width and bounds.height divided by Number(settings().zoom) || 1
pipelineGeometry.paths: PathBuilder.stroke(1), cubic connections derived from the same node/slot coordinates as hit targets.
pipelineGeometry.planner: 110 diameter; orbit radius 86 with dash array [3, 7]
pipelineGeometry.compactNode: 18 diameter comet while routing; 16 diameter star when completed

preview.reason: The design panel's HTML/CSS shadow-DOM renderer cannot faithfully render native GPUI controls or obtain Herdr's dynamic theme and UI font. Native constructions and semantic bindings are retained below; empty html/css fields deliberately avoid a fabricated browser substitute.
preview.staticColorPrimitives: Omitted: dynamic host roles have no canonical fixed color value in this repository.
preview.tonalRamps: Omitted: no mod-owned tonal ramp exists, and synthesizing one would introduce a separate palette.

narrative.overview:
Herdr Mods extends a native GPUI desktop workspace. Its controls, typography, focus behavior and semantic colors belong to Herdr. The visual character is compact, quiet and practical: clear text, small icons, restrained rounding and thin separators keep project context close to terminal work.

Pipeline inherits this system. Its approved spatial constellation gives dispatch room to be understood, while its controls and inspector keep the same native character. This document records the incumbent implementation; it introduces no new visual identity or raster artwork. Pipeline's surface strategy remains in [its direction contract](docs/pipeline.md).
keyCharacteristics: Dynamic host theme and inherited UI font.
Compact controls, explicit states and keyboard access.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and thin strokes.
Spatial geometry for Pipeline, with scrolling for constrained panes.

rules.name: The Native Theme Rule
rules.body: Resolve colors from Herdr at render time; preserve semantic foreground/background pairs instead of freezing a screenshot's palette.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Pair state color with a readable label, icon or accessible name. A colored dot alone does not explain dispatch, waiting, failure or review.

dos: **Do** use Herdr's dynamic semantic theme roles and inherited UI font.
**Do** reuse native buttons, fields, tooltips, focus handles and list scrolling.
**Do** keep state names visible alongside color and explain why work waits.
**Do** normalize painted bounds by app zoom before applying Pipeline geometry.
**Do** preserve occupied work slots and full queue access when limits or pane sizes change.
**Do** preserve immediate, understandable state updates when motion is disabled.
donts: **Don't** freeze host colors or the UI font into a separate mod identity.
**Don't** replace native controls with web-style imitations or inferred browser tokens.
**Don't** turn Pipeline's constellation into a required layout for ordinary list panels.
**Don't** hide queued work behind the canvas preview's item limit.
**Don't** add decorative shadows or raster artwork to describe this incumbent system.
